units.displayText: It seems Malkira's "gift" to us... was not the Rubik's Map.

spans.text: It seems Malkira's "gift" to us... was not the Rubik's Map.

units.rawText: So, it's...
units.displayText: So, it's...

spans.text: So, it's...

units.rawText: This reunion after a long time apart was truly a surprise, so the gift in question is most likely Sol.
units.displayText: This reunion after a long time apart was truly a surprise, so the gift in question is most likely Sol.

spans.text: This reunion after a long time apart was truly a surprise, so the gift in question is most likely Sol.

units.rawText: Sol has forgotten her past and greeted us with her blade. All this is part of Malkira's plan... but to what end?
units.displayText: Sol has forgotten her past and greeted us with her blade. All this is part of Malkira's plan... but to what end?

spans.text: Sol has forgotten her past and greeted us with her blade. All this is part of Malkira's plan... but to what end?

units.rawText: The advantage that the Entropics currently hold clearly indicates that all they have to do is quietly wait for events to unfold. If she wanted to get rid of us, she had countless opportunities to do so.
units.displayText: The advantage that the Entropics currently hold clearly indicates that all they have to do is quietly wait for events to unfold. If she wanted to get rid of us, she had countless opportunities to do so.

spans.text: The advantage that the Entropics currently hold clearly indicates that all they have to do is quietly wait for events to unfold. If she wanted to get rid of us, she had countless opportunities to do so.

units.rawText: Yet she has chosen to negotiate with you and guided us here, even arranging for us to meet Sol again.
units.displayText: Yet she has chosen to negotiate with you and guided us here, even arranging for us to meet Sol again.

spans.text: Yet she has chosen to negotiate with you and guided us here, even arranging for us to meet Sol again.

units.rawText: The silvery surface of the Rubik's Map reflects our faces. The moving glints of light on its surface seem to bind our destiny to that of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: The silvery surface of the Rubik's Map reflects our faces. The moving glints of light on its surface seem to bind our destiny to that of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: The silvery surface of the Rubik's Map reflects our faces. The moving glints of light on its surface seem to bind our destiny to that of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: It seems that Tartarus has the upper hand now. Are you still willing to negotiate with us at a time like this?
units.displayText: It seems that Tartarus has the upper hand now. Are you still willing to negotiate with us at a time like this?

spans.text: It seems that Tartarus has the upper hand now. Are you still willing to negotiate with us at a time like this?

units.rawText: <color=red>Of course. You are worthy of the lengths I have gone to in order to facilitate this meeting. In turn, I would like you to negotiate with me with similar sincerity.</color>
units.displayText: Of course. You are worthy of the lengths I have gone to in order to facilitate this meeting. In turn, I would like you to negotiate with me with similar sincerity.

spans.text: Of course. You are worthy of the lengths I have gone to in order to facilitate this meeting. In turn, I would like you to negotiate with me with similar sincerity.

units.rawText: <color=red>The Entropics are not given to kindness. I hope you will live up to the honor that has been bestowed upon you, <cmdr>.</color>
units.displayText: The Entropics are not given to kindness. I hope you will live up to the honor that has been bestowed upon you, {교수}.

spans.text: The Entropics are not given to kindness. I hope you will live up to the honor that has been bestowed upon you,

units.rawText: Malkira told us the answer from the beginning.
units.displayText: Malkira told us the answer from the beginning.

spans.text: Malkira told us the answer from the beginning.

units.rawText: Everyone wants to use this battle to turn the tables on their current situation. Eosphorus wants to escape to reality. We want to stop the Entropization of Magrasea. But what does Malkira want?
units.displayText: Everyone wants to use this battle to turn the tables on their current situation. Eosphorus wants to escape to reality. We want to stop the Entropization of Magrasea. But what does Malkira want?

spans.text: Everyone wants to use this battle to turn the tables on their current situation. Eosphorus wants to escape to reality. We want to stop the Entropization of Magrasea. But what does Malkira want?

units.rawText: Right now, she is protecting us and deceiving Eosphorus, creating a chance for us to meet. That implies that her fate cannot be changed, even if all of Magrasea is Entropized and Eosphorus makes it to reality.
units.displayText: Right now, she is protecting us and deceiving Eosphorus, creating a chance for us to meet. That implies that her fate cannot be changed, even if all of Magrasea is Entropized and Eosphorus makes it to reality.

spans.text: Right now, she is protecting us and deceiving Eosphorus, creating a chance for us to meet. That implies that her fate cannot be changed, even if all of Magrasea is Entropized and Eosphorus makes it to reality.

units.rawText: Perhaps the ants crawling on the Mobius strip have a way of upsetting the status quo.
units.displayText: Perhaps the ants crawling on the Mobius strip have a way of upsetting the status quo.

spans.text: Perhaps the ants crawling on the Mobius strip have a way of upsetting the status quo.

units.rawText: Having come from beyond the cloud and transcended the bindings laid down by its creators, her objective...
units.displayText: Having come from beyond the cloud and transcended the bindings laid down by its creators, her objective...

spans.text: Having come from beyond the cloud and transcended the bindings laid down by its creators, her objective...

units.rawText: ...Is us.
units.displayText: ...Is us.

spans.text: ...Is us.

units.rawText: Beep-beep—
units.displayText: Beep-beep—

spans.text: Beep-beep—

units.rawText: Signal fluctuation detected. Locator has insufficient operands.
units.displayText: Signal fluctuation detected. Locator has insufficient operands.

spans.text: Signal fluctuation detected. Locator has insufficient operands.

units.rawText: The sudden popup notification breaks the oppressive mood in the air.
units.displayText: The sudden popup notification breaks the oppressive mood in the air.

spans.text: The sudden popup notification breaks the oppressive mood in the air.

units.rawText: The warning from the tracker indicates that it might not hold out until we find Sol again.
units.displayText: The warning from the tracker indicates that it might not hold out until we find Sol again.

spans.text: The warning from the tracker indicates that it might not hold out until we find Sol again.

units.rawText: Let's hurry, Professor.
units.displayText: Let's hurry, Professor.

spans.text: Let's hurry, Professor.

units.rawText: Yes. I'll try to use the Rubik's Map to find the location of the tracker.
units.displayText: Yes. I'll try to use the Rubik's Map to find the location of the tracker.

spans.text: Yes. I'll try to use the Rubik's Map to find the location of the tracker.

units.rawText: After entering the appropriate coordinates, the Map's components shift and realign, processing the target's movements and revealing a destination coordinate.
units.displayText: After entering the appropriate coordinates, the Map's components shift and realign, processing the target's movements and revealing a destination coordinate.

spans.text: After entering the appropriate coordinates, the Map's components shift and realign, processing the target's movements and revealing a destination coordinate.

units.rawText: ...It's in the Middle Ring of Tartarus.
units.displayText: ...It's in the Middle Ring of Tartarus.

spans.text: ...It's in the Middle Ring of Tartarus.

units.rawText: I wonder if this is lucky or unlucky; Sol is currently in the place where we're headed.
units.displayText: I wonder if this is lucky or unlucky; Sol is currently in the place where we're headed.

spans.text: I wonder if this is lucky or unlucky; Sol is currently in the place where we're headed.

units.rawText: Looks like there's no avoiding this reunion... Let's go.
units.displayText: Looks like there's no avoiding this reunion... Let's go.

spans.text: Looks like there's no avoiding this reunion... Let's go.

units.rawText: Our battle with Sol has left us severely wounded.
units.displayText: Our battle with Sol has left us severely wounded.

spans.text: Our battle with Sol has left us severely wounded.

units.rawText: Sorry, fallen debris trapped me in the room with the Rubik's Map and it took me a long time to get free, so I couldn't help you right away. How are your injuries, Persicaria?
